summary: SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: wykonaj. Execute Planfile PLF-102 / GitHub #208. Bound store and index flock waits, report contention without reclaiming ownership, preserve ticket/outbox data and recover after lock-holder exit.

delivery.outcome: Contending mutation/index flock acquisition ends within a bounded budget without taking ownership or changing durable data.
nonGoals: No forced unlock, owner process termination, storage migration, dependency change or synchronization policy change.

architecture.decision: Use nonblocking flock retries with a monotonic deadline; unlock only an acquired descriptor. Kernel PID lookup is advisory.
architecture.rollback: Revert locking helper; no persisted data migration.

commands: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_store_lock_timeout.py tests/test_store_concurrency.py tests/test_sqlite_ticket_index.py tests/test_ticket_evidence.py
validation.evidence: 67 tests passed and read-only live lock contention returned in 0.213 s preserving the existing owner.
